# Expanded View Figures

![](figures/figureS_alad_cohort/figureS_alad_cohort.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label alad-cohort >}}.
ALAD cohort and cell type composition.** ({{< panel alad-cohort cohort >}}) Schematic of the ALAD cohort data\ [@doi:10.1016/j.healun.2024.02.007].
({{< panel alad-cohort celltype-proportions >}}) Fraction of each sample's cells in each annotated cell type for control, declined ALAD, and recovered ALAD samples, on a square-root scale.
Boxes show the median and interquartile range and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the interquartile range.
q: Kruskal--Wallis test across the three groups, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across cell types.

![](figures/figureS_cmp5_identity/figureS_cmp5_identity.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label cmp5-identity >}}.
ALAD CPD component 5 sender and receiver cell identity.** ({{< panel cmp5-identity eigenstate-scatter >}}) Per-cell projection onto the eigen-states most heavily weighted by component 5's sender (eigen-state 17) and receiver (eigen-state 15) factors.
({{< panel cmp5-identity cmp-eigenstate-loadings >}}) Component 5 sender and receiver eigen-state loadings.
({{< panel cmp5-identity celltype-markers >}}) Expression of canonical respiratory cell type markers in component 5's sender/receiver groups and all other cells\ [@doi:10.1038/s41586-020-2922-4; @doi:10.1038/s41591-023-02327-2].
({{< panel cmp5-identity group-vs-rest sender-vs-receiver >}}) Difference in the fraction of cells detecting each gene against its Wilcoxon rank-sum q (Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across all genes) between ({{< panel cmp5-identity group-vs-rest.1 >}}) sender and all other cells, ({{< panel cmp5-identity group-vs-rest.2 >}}) receiver and all other cells, and ({{< panel cmp5-identity sender-vs-receiver >}}) sender and receiver cells.
Labeled are ({{< panel cmp5-identity group-vs-rest >}}) canonical pan-epithelial markers and ({{< panel cmp5-identity sender-vs-receiver >}}) epithelium-specific genes selected from those differentially expressed between the groups.
({{< panel cmp5-identity tau-sweep >}}) Sender versus receiver Wilcoxon rank-sum q of each epithelial subtype marker shown in {{< fig 2 epithelial-markers >}} (Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across these markers) across group cutoffs τ, signed positive when higher in sender cells; dotted line: τ = 0.3 used throughout, dashed lines: q = 0.05.
({{< panel cmp5-identity receiver-genes >}}) Gene loadings of eigen-state 15, the eigen-state most heavily weighted by component 5's receiver factor, by rank; the 30 highest-loading genes are labeled.

![](figures/figureS_ccc_scoring/figureS_ccc_scoring.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label ccc-scoring >}}.
CCC-RISE components across communication scoring methods.** ({{< panel ccc-scoring factor-match.1 >}}) Match score (mean \|cosine\| over the condition and LR pair modes) of each CPD component of the product score to its Hungarian-matched component under each alternate score.
({{< panel ccc-scoring factor-match.2 >}}) Mean sender and receiver \|cosine\| of the matched components, an independent check of the matching.
({{< panel ccc-scoring anova >}}) ANOVA η^2^ of each CPD component's condition loadings against six-month outcome under each score, numbered by the matched product-score component.
\*: p < 0.05.
({{< panel ccc-scoring interpretation.1 >}}) LR pair and ({{< panel ccc-scoring interpretation.2 >}}) mean sender and receiver cell-type loadings of each matched component under each score, each divided by its largest absolute loading within the component and score.
LR pairs shown are the union of each score's top 3.

![](figures/figureS_ibd_hormone_axes/figureS_ibd_hormone_axes.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label ibd-hormone-axes >}}.
IBD CPD component 3 and 4 hormone-signaling cell identities.** ({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes eigenstate-loadings >}}) Sender and receiver eigen-state loadings of top-loaded eigen-states (absolute loading ≥ 0.2) in components 3 and 4.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes eigenstate-association >}}) Eigen-state--cell-type associations of top-loaded eigen-states in components 3 and 4: mean RISE projection of each cell type's cells.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes eigenstate-composition >}}) Annotated cell-type compositions of top-loaded eigen-states in components 3 and 4, using IBDverse annotations: each cell type's share of the eigen-state's squared projection over all cells.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes cell-map >}}) RISE projection embedding of all cells in IBDverse, showing every EE, EC, and tuft cell and 100,000 randomly drawn other cells.
Labels are colored by coarse cell type: coarse cell types in bold on their clusters, and fine EE, EC, and tuft cell types in normal font with lines to their cluster centers.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receiver-maps.1 >}}, {{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receiver-maps.2 >}}) RISE projection embeddings of all EE, EC, and tuft cells colored by CPD component ({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receiver-maps.1 >}}) 3 and ({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receiver-maps.2 >}}) 4 per-cell receiver weight.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receptor-maps.1 >}}, {{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receptor-maps.2 >}}) Same as ({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receiver-maps.1 >}}, {{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receiver-maps.2 >}}), colored by ({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receptor-maps.1 >}}) NPY1R and ({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes receptor-maps.2 >}}) GLP1R gene expression normalized to the top 1% of expressing cells.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes type-map >}}) RISE projection embeddings of EE, EC, and tuft cells colored by cell type as annotated in IBDverse.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes magnitude-hist >}}) Distribution of EE cells over polar magnitudes, as in {{< fig 4 hormone-angle-scatter >}}.
Dashed line: the magnitude threshold (0.3) used to group cells in {{< fig 4 hormone-angle-hist hormone-extreme-markers >}}.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes marker-floor-sweep >}}) q-values signifying the significance of gene expression differences in villus- and crypt-like cells, swept over polar magnitude threshold.
Genes shown are the six with the highest q-value at any magnitude of those listed in {{< fig 4 hormone-extreme-markers >}}.
Dotted line: the magnitude threshold used in {{< fig 4 hormone-extreme-markers >}}; dashed line: q = 0.05.
q: Mann--Whitney U test, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across all markers tested at each threshold.
({{< panel ibd-hormone-axes extreme-share >}}) Contribution of EE cell groups to total EE cell population stratified by biopsy type, for biopsies with at least 3 EE cells (healthy, n = 200; CD uninflamed, n = 44; CD inflamed, n = 45).
Boxes show the median and interquartile range and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the interquartile range.
q: Kruskal--Wallis test across the three groups, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across EE cell groups.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_classes/figureS_comparator_classes.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-classes >}}.
Classes of comparator LR columns.** Every comparator LR column of {{< fig 5 column-census >}}, colored by its class; the rules apply in order, and dashed lines mark their cutoffs.
({{< panel comparator-classes span-containment >}}) Containment in CCC-RISE's LR pair span; columns contained at 0.85 or more and above their permutation null are the same as a CCC-RISE program.
({{< panel comparator-classes program-overlap >}}) Share of each remaining column's squared loading on one component's carrying pairs; labels name the component of columns at 0.5 or more.
({{< panel comparator-classes column-breadth >}}) Effective LR pairs; columns with 20 or more are broad, and those left with fewer than 1.5 are single pairs.
({{< panel comparator-classes homophilic-share >}}) Homophilic share of the columns left; columns at 0.8 or more are homophilic adhesion, and the rest mixed pairs.
